The Melting Pot's Duluth location is closing on May 31, 2026, after a 36-year run in the community. The owners are hosting a Final Dip Celebration Weekend from May 29–31 featuring special dining experiences and commemorative keepsakes. The chain will continue operating locations in Roswell, Kennesaw, and Midtown Atlanta.

Vilebrequin La Plage, a Riviera-inspired rooftop restaurant and poolside destination, has opened atop the UNFRAMED, Autograph Collection hotel in Miami Beach. The concept is a collaboration between French swimwear brand Vilebrequin and hospitality group 34th Floor, Schulte F&B Group, and marks the brand's U.S. debut. The venue offers French-inspired coastal cuisine, a rooftop lounge, and resort-style offerings.

Uncle Fluffy opened its second Orange County location on May 23, 2026, at Triangle Square in Costa Mesa. The Japanese cheesecake and dessert cafe is known for its light, fluffy Japanese-style cheesecakes, tarts, macarons, mochi, and specialty beverages. This is the family-owned brand's latest addition to its expanding California footprint.

slice/25, a new rooftop pizza-and-wine concept, debuted on May 21, 2026, atop Grand Hyatt Nashville as part of the existing lou/na rooftop venue. The restaurant offers artisanal pizzas alongside curated wine pairings with panoramic skyline views from the 25th floor. The space operates during lou/na's regular hours on a walk-in basis only.

A new Toastique location is set to open in Johns Creek this summer, operated by husband-and-wife team Steve and Randi Rubin. The cafe will offer gourmet toast, juice, coffee, smoothies, superfood bowls, and cold-pressed juices. The location is positioned near schools, fitness studios, and other health-focused businesses.

Local restaurateur Okan Ozyurteri is bringing Mozaika Mezze, a Mediterranean dining concept featuring Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese flavors, to Buckhead this fall. The menu will include small-plate mezze and wood-grilled skewers. No specific address was mentioned in the article.

Bizarre Coffee Company is opening its fourth location in Downtown Acworth, which is currently under construction. The brand is known for specialty coffee and a community-driven, eclectic atmosphere. No opening date or specific address was provided in the article.

Phia, a new Appalachian cuisine concept helmed by Chef Brad Feickert, is planned to open in August 2026 at 304 Carroll Street NW in Takoma, DC, in the space formerly occupied by La Mano Coffee Bar. The restaurant will offer "Appalachian grassroots cuisine" with a beverage program highlighting Appalachian-sourced ingredients overseen by Dylan Greer.

data.location: Between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road, Stafford County, VA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Buc-ee's has received approval from the Stafford County Board of Supervisors to open a 74,000-square-foot travel center location between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road in Stafford County, Virginia. The location will feature 120 fuel pumps and over 800 parking spaces, though no opening timeline has been announced. The concept's application had been under review for over two years.

data.location: 5063 Wellington Road, Gainesville, VA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Honeygrow is preparing to open a new location at 5063 Wellington Road in Gainesville, Virginia, with no firm opening date yet announced. The fast-casual chain, founded in Philadelphia in 2012, is known for customizable stir-fries and healthier menu options. The company website lists the location as "coming soon."

The Boston Licensing Board approved plans on May 7 for King Bee, a new restaurant and live entertainment venue to be built in three former industrial buildings at 202 West First Street in South Boston. The project from Beehive owner Jack Bardy will include a restaurant, cocktail bars, and live entertainment spaces. No opening timeline has been confirmed as many design and programming details are still evolving.

The Reserve Key West is a planned culinary collective to be housed in a converted bank building at 510 Southard Street in Key West's Old Town neighborhood. The venue will feature multiple restaurant concepts, a rotating bar, and a hidden speakeasy called The Vault inside the original bank vault. No specific opening date has been announced beyond "coming in 2026."

data.location: 500 W 7th St, Suite 175, Fort Worth, TX 76102
data.short_description: Almacen El Gallo, an elevated yet affordable Mexican cuisine concept from Burciaga Hospitality Group, aims to open in mid-to-late June 2026 inside First on 7th, the former First National Bank of Fort Worth. The menu, created by chef Rodrigo Rivera Río, is inspired by memory and tradition and will feature grilled meats, barbacoa, moles, adobos, stews, and broths. If successful, expansion into Dallas, Frisco, or Houston markets is under consideration.

Loaded Cafe is gearing up to open its 10th location in Civic Center Plaza in Norwalk, alongside sister concept My Panecito. The Southern California chain launched in Long Beach in 2012 and is known for combining classic American dishes with Mexican flavors. An exact opening timeline has not been confirmed.

My Panecito, a panadería known for pastries such as conchas, is set to open its fifth location at Civic Center Plaza in Norwalk alongside sister concept Loaded Cafe. No exact opening date has been confirmed. The brand currently has locations in Gardena, Orange, Placentia, and Bell.

data.location: 617 E Liberty St, Ann Arbor, MI 48104
data.short_description: Orijin Bakery, a new concept from Sava Farah and executive pastry chef Jin Capobianco Gorian of The Pulpo Group, is planned to open in early August at 617 E Liberty Street in downtown Ann Arbor. The bakery will serve pastries from The Boro alongside new savory breads, with the drinks program still unconfirmed. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

Good God, Nadine's announced on May 21, 2026, that it will serve its final meal on May 31, 2026, following the sale of the property it occupies. The cocktail bar and Gulf Coast-inspired restaurant completed approximately one year in operation before the closure. The team cited the building sale as the reason for closing.

Pinnacle Brewing is planning to open a second Valley location in Downtown Mesa at 104 W. Main St., targeting a 2027 opening. The family-owned brewery, which first debuted in Scottsdale in 2024, will occupy a space previously home to The Boutique. A food program for the new taproom and kitchen has yet to be announced.

data.location: 9324 Clifford St, Suite 102, Fort Worth, TX 76108
data.short_description: Orange Leaf Yogurt will open a new location at Clifford Crossings in Fort Worth, with renovations expected to begin in June 2026 and a target opening of mid-August. The 1,279-square-foot store will offer frozen yogurt, shakes, and crepes, and will be the 17th Orange Leaf location in Texas and the fourth in Fort Worth. A new ice cream sandwich product is also planned to debut at the location.

Gold Palm, a restaurant and cocktail bar located at 1900 Telegraph Avenue in Oakland, will serve its last dinner on May 27, 2026, due to ongoing financial challenges. The restaurant, which opened in 2024, cited unsustainable economics as the reason for closure, noting the business performed well but not well enough to continue. The adjoining cocktail bar, Moonglow, will remain open and continue operating.

Crust Simply Italian's planned Mesa location at The Grid development in Downtown Mesa had faced construction delays but is now moving forward again. No official opening date or address has been announced. The brand currently operates locations in Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, and Peoria.

Avondale is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location. No official timeline or address has been announced. The Arizona-based Italian restaurant brand is continuing to evaluate expansion opportunities across the Valley.

Surprise is among the Valley communities now under consideration for a future Crust Simply Italian location. No official timeline or address has been announced. The Arizona-based Italian restaurant brand is continuing to evaluate expansion opportunities across the Valley.

L&L Hawaiian Barbecue opened a new location on May 11, 2026, at La Costa Town Square in Carlsbad, marking the brand's 100th location in California. The location is owned by franchisee Chloe Tran and serves Hawaiian plate lunches including BBQ Mix, Chicken Katsu, Kalua Pork, Loco Moco, and Garlic Shrimp. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, mobile-app ordering, third-party delivery, and catering services.

data.location: 9325 JW Clay Blvd, Suite 211, Charlotte, NC 28262
data.short_description: A new Palm Berries location is preparing to open near Charlotte's university area, marking the franchise owner's third location. The health-focused concept offers acai bowls, smoothies, and fresh-cut fruit, with an emphasis on speed and hospitality. Further opening details are expected to be announced closer to launch.

data.location: 606 Broadway E., Seattle, WA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Bait Shop, a Capitol Hill bar operating at its Broadway address since 2012, is being forced to relocate due to planned demolition and redevelopment of its building. No new address or timeline has been finalized, though co-owners hope to remain on Capitol Hill. The lack of a firm landlord timeline has made planning difficult.

Franchisees Jeff and Becky Montie, along with Robbin and Jimmy McCullen, are expanding Palm Berries across North Carolina. The first confirmed location at Quail Corners in south Charlotte is targeting a mid-June opening.

data.location: 16631 Lancaster Highway, Ballantyne, Charlotte, NC (zip not specified)
data.status: hope to open this unit by late summer
data.short_description: Part of the same multi-location franchise expansion by the Montie and McCullen families, the Ballantyne location is the second planned opening. The group is targeting late summer for this unit.
A third Palm Berries location is in the works for Winston-Salem, with the team nearing a signed lease agreement. No address or opening date has been confirmed.

James Beard Award winners Jody Williams and Rita Sodi are opening a second location of their Bar Pisellino café inside the Flatiron Building. Construction is set to begin in summer 2026, with the restaurant expected to open in 2027. The all-day concept will offer light fare, a full coffee program, and a full bar.
